recipe.title: Tkemali
recipe.headnote: Sour plums, not ripe ones. A sweet plum makes a chutney, and the point of tkemali is that it is sharp enough to cut through grilled pork fat.
method: Simmer the plums in a splash of water until they collapse, about 20 minutes.
Push them through a sieve to leave the skins behind, or leave them in for a rougher sauce.
Pound the garlic, herbs and spices with a good pinch of salt and stir that into the warm purée.
Thin with water until it pours thickly from a spoon. Taste for salt and cool before serving.

plating.text: Keeps a week in the fridge and freezes well. Make a double batch while sour plums are around.
